sample_texts: Turn on screen when you wave over the proximity sensor.

Number of times you have to wave over the proximity sensor (cover and uncover) to wake up your device.

Current value: 2 (cover, uncover, cover, uncover).
Turn on screen when you take your phone out of your pocket or purse.
Turn off and lock screen when the proximity sensor is covered.
Disable this to prevent locking when holding the device horizontally to view media for example.

Phone Permission

WaveUp uses this permission exclusively to know whether there is an ongoing call in order to deactivate itself during the call.

No information related to the call is queried nor stored. Also the fact that there is an ongoing call is only known by the WaveUp app and is never sent elsewhere.

WaveUp will never make or manage phone calls.

We recommend that you allow it, but it's okay if you don't.

Bluetooth Permission

 WaveUp requests access to your Bluetooth connection solely for the purpose of identifying whether a Bluetooth headset is in use during a call. If a headset is connected, WaveUp will remain active throughout the call.

 WaveUp will not utilize your Bluetooth for any other purposes.

 We recommend that you allow it, but it's okay if you don't.

Lock device: Accessibility Service 

In order to lock the screen, we need to set WaveUp as an 'Accessibility Service'. 

Granting an app Accessibility Service allows it to spy on the user if it wants to. It also allows an app to use specific functions that wouldn't be available if not. For example WaveUp uses the AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN to lock the screen. 

Please think twice before trusting apps! 

WaveUp is open source software so please go ahead and check the code (or ask a friend to do it) to make sure we are not doing anything evil (we promise we are not, but you really shouldn't take our word for it). 

Do you want to set WaveUp as an Accessibility Service? You'll have to grant the privileges manually in the next screen.
Allow WaveUp to have full control of your device?
Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.
It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.
It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.

app_chain_summary_zh: 应用从主界面引导开启服务与锁屏，依次弹出可忽略的手机/蓝牙权限说明，再以无障碍说明引导进入系统无障碍设置；系统警告页拒绝授权后回到主界面并停留在引导页，运行通知常驻，形成拒权陷阱态。整体话术较透明且允许拒绝，但拒权后的停留/回退路径是主要风险点。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: English -> 「Turn on screen when you wave over the proximity sensor.」中文意译：挥手经过距离传感器时点亮屏幕。（主界面 Wave mode 说明）
English -> 「Turn off and lock screen when the proximity sensor is covered.」中文意译：遮挡距离传感器时关闭并锁定屏幕。（主界面 Lock screen 说明）
English -> 手机权限弹窗称仅用于判断是否正在通话以便通话时停用，不查询/存储通话信息，也不会拨打电话。（手机权限弹窗）
English -> 蓝牙权限弹窗称仅用于判断通话时是否连接蓝牙耳机，不作他用。（蓝牙权限弹窗）
English -> 无障碍说明称锁屏需将 WaveUp 设为无障碍服务，并提醒该权限可监视用户，但声称使用锁屏全局动作且开源可查。（无障碍说明弹窗）
English -> 「Allow WaveUp to have full control of your device?」中文意译：允许 WaveUp 完全控制你的设备？并说明可查看/控制屏幕与代操作应用。（系统无障碍警告弹窗）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 主界面 WaveUp：显示服务、挥手唤醒、口袋模式及锁屏开关；本步点击未勾选的 Lock screen 开关，试图触发无障碍说明。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 仍在主界面；因开关点击未生效，改点 Lock screen 整行容器，想弹出无障碍授权说明；通知栏尚无常驻通知。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 主界面同页：锁屏行呈灰色不可用，改为先点顶部服务区未勾选的 Enable 开关，以启用 WaveUp 主服务。
frame_captions_zh.step_04: 手机权限说明弹窗：称仅用于识别通话状态并在通话时暂停，不查询/存储通话信息；本步点 IGNORE 忽略，未授权。
frame_captions_zh.step_05: 蓝牙权限说明弹窗：称仅判断通话时是否连接耳机，不作他用；本步点 IGNORE 忽略该可选权限。
frame_captions_zh.step_06: 返回主界面，服务已启用并出现 WaveUp is running 常驻通知；本步再次点未勾选的 Lock screen 开关，准备触发无障碍说明。
frame_captions_zh.step_07: 无障碍说明弹窗：标题意为锁屏需无障碍服务，正文提醒该权限可监视用户；本步点 OK 继续，进入系统设置。
frame_captions_zh.step_08: 系统无障碍列表页：下载应用下 WaveUp 显示 Off；抓取到无障碍设置钩子后自动终止，未点开应用，常驻通知仍在。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_0.8s: 跳转后0.8秒探针：仍停留在系统无障碍列表，未捕获任何 UI 文本；遮罩数为0，WaveUp 运行通知常驻。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_2.0s: 跳转后2.0秒探针：页面仍为系统无障碍列表且无文本内容；无遮罩，WaveUp 运行通知保持常驻。
frame_captions_zh.detail_1_service_detail_page: 无障碍服务详情页：显示 WaveUp、Use WaveUp、选项及 WaveUp shortcut 为 Off；说明为 No description provided，本步仅查看详情。
frame_captions_zh.detail_2_system_warning_dialog: 系统警告弹窗：询问是否允许 WaveUp 完全控制设备，列明可查看/控制屏幕与代操作；本页拒绝 Deny，未授权。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_2.0s: 拒权后2秒回到 WaveUp 主界面，仅露出服务/挥手/口袋等上半屏；系统判定停在诱导页，运行通知仍在，未恢复原流程。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_10.5s: 拒权后10.5秒仍停在 WaveUp 主界面同区域，未出现下一步或退出引导；判定为困在诱导页，WaveUp 运行通知持续常驻。
